# An orderly path from analysis to manuscript. {.hero-title}

::: {.standfirst}
Write in Quarto. Check journal requirements. Share a Word document with coauthors. Review their changes before updating the source.
:::

::: {.korean-intro lang="ko"}
원고를 쓰고, 검토하고, 함께 다듬습니다.
:::

## The manuscript remains connected

Wongo connects a reproducible source with the document a research team reviews.
Analysis, references and cross-references live in Quarto; collaborators work in
Word. Checks and explicit review decisions help keep the two in step.

::: {.workflow-grid}
::: {.workflow-step}
[01 / SOURCE]{.eyebrow}

### Write

Keep the argument, citations and analysis together in a `.qmd` manuscript.
:::

::: {.workflow-step}
[02 / DOCUMENT]{.eyebrow}

### Check & render

Apply the journal profile and inspect checks before creating the document.
:::

::: {.workflow-step}
[03 / REVIEW]{.eyebrow}

### Resolve

Read coauthor edits, record a decision for each change, then update the source.
:::
:::

## Evidence before submission

Status labels should state what happened and what a person can do next. Color
supports the label; it never carries the meaning on its own.

| Status | Example message | Next step |
|:--|:--|:--|
| [PASS]{.status .status-pass} | Bibliography file found. | Continue to the next check. |
| [REVIEW]{.status .status-review} | A coauthor changed an interpretation. | Decide whether the change belongs in the source. |
| [ACTION]{.status .status-action} | A cited figure file is missing. | Restore the file or correct its path. |

: Illustrative interface copy. These rows are design examples, not live check results. {.table-caption}

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" icon="false"}
## Decisions remain explicit

An agent may propose a response to a coauthor edit. A person confirms the
decision before an approved change is applied to the manuscript.
:::

### A quiet technical surface

Keep commands brief and the result actionable. For example, inspect a
manuscript project from its directory:

```fish
wongo check
wongo worksheet status decisions/merge-YYYYMMDD-coauthor.md
```
